integrity: Both displayed generator matrices are checked exactly. The common primal enumerator is obtained by complete enumeration of all \(25\) messages; both full dual enumerators are obtained independently by exact syndrome dynamic programming; and the sharpness cutoff exhausts every twelve-orbit multiplicity vector of effective length at most \(8\) whose columns span \(\mathbb F_5^2\).
scientific_limitations: The minimality statement is restricted to effective dimension-\(2\) codes over \(\mathbb F_5\) and to failures detected by the dual Euclidean weight-\(2\) coefficient. It does not exclude shorter counterexamples in other dimensions or whose first dual discrepancy occurs at a larger Euclidean weight, and it does not classify all length-\(9\) witnesses.
title: A sharp length-\(9\) dual-weight-two witness for Euclidean weight over \(\mathbb F_5\)
